units.source_text: 这天晚上，源氏在花散里处住宿，和她闲谈。

en.t: That evening, Genji stayed at Hanachirusato's residence and chatted idly with her.

units.source_text: 他对她说：“兵部卿亲王比别人优越呢。

en.t: He said to her, "The Prince Minister of War is superior to other people.

units.source_text: 相貌虽不十分出色，但性情态度都很高雅，是个风流公子。

en.t: Though his looks are not especially outstanding, his nature and bearing are both very refined, and he is an elegant gentleman.

units.source_text: 你以前窥见过他么？

en.t: Have you ever caught sight of him before?

units.source_text: 大家极口称赞他，然而也有美中不足之处。”

en.t: Everyone praises him to the skies, yet even he has a flaw in all that excellence."

units.source_text: 花散里答道：“他是你的弟弟，但看样子似乎比你年长。

en.t: Hanachirusato replied, "He is your younger brother, but from his appearance he seems older than you.

units.source_text: 听说近来他常常到这里来，很是亲睦。

en.t: I hear that lately he often comes here and is on very close terms with everyone.

units.source_text: 但我自从很久以前在宫中窥见一面之后，长久没见他。

en.t: But ever since I caught a glimpse of him long ago at court, I have not seen him for a very long time.

units.source_text: 我看他的相貌比从前漂亮得多了。

en.t: To my eyes, his appearance has become much more beautiful than before.

units.source_text: 他的弟弟帅亲王也很漂亮，然而品格不及他好，倒像个国王的模样。”

en.t: His younger brother, the Sochi Prince, is also very handsome, but his character is not as fine as his, and he looks more like a king."

units.source_text: 源氏听了她的话，觉得这个人真眼快，一看便知好歹。

en.t: Hearing her words, Genji thought that she was truly sharp-eyed, able to tell good from bad at a glance.

units.source_text: 但他只是微笑，不再评论其他诸人的美丑。

en.t: But he merely smiled and made no further comments on the beauty or plainness of the others.

units.source_text: 原来他认为指人缺陷，对人贬斥，是无知之人的妄谈。

en.t: For he believed that pointing out people's defects and disparaging them was the reckless talk of the ignorant.

units.source_text: 所以，世人都称赞髭黑大将人品高雅，

en.t: Therefore, although everyone in the world praised the Higekuro General as a man of refined character,

units.source_text: 他虽然觉得此人做他的女婿还嫌不够，但绝不出之于口。

en.t: even though Genji felt that this man was still not quite good enough to be his son-in-law, he never said so aloud.

units.source_text: 他和花散里，现在只是一般的亲睦关系，晚上也分铺而睡。

en.t: He and Hanachirusato were now simply on ordinary friendly terms, and even at night they slept in separate bedding.

units.source_text: 为什么弄得如此疏远呢？

en.t: Why had things become so distant between them?

units.source_text: 他想起了颇觉痛苦。

en.t: When he thought of this, he felt considerable pain.

units.source_text: 原来花散里为人谦虚，从来不申恨诉怨。

en.t: For Hanachirusato was modest by nature and had never voiced resentment or complaint.

units.source_text: 年来春秋游宴之事，她都不参与，只从别人口中传闻情状。

en.t: For years she had taken no part in the spring and autumn outings and banquets, learning about them only through what others told her.

units.source_text: 所以今天难得在这里举行盛大集会，在她觉得是她这院子的无上光荣。

en.t: So the rare holding of a grand gathering here today seemed to her the highest honor for her own residence.

units.source_text: 此时她吟诗道：

en.t: At this moment, she composed a poem and said:
